The control status is the sole run lifecycle vocabulary; scheduler activity and process liveness never substitute for it:

| Status | Meaning | Stable invariant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| draft | Required inputs or configuration are incomplete. | No scheduler or worker may start. |
| ready | Readiness gates pass and activation may be requested. | Activation cannot alter RunInputs. |
| active | Autonomous scheduling authority is enabled. | The run holds the project dispatch lease. |
| draining | New admission is disabled while existing work settles. | No new claims are created. |
| paused | Scheduling is disabled and the run remains resumable. | Work has settled or explicit recovery recorded its cancellations. |
| completed | Autonomous work closed normally. | The run is terminal. |
| failed | The runner cannot continue safely. | Recovery returns the same run to paused. |
| cancelled | The operator abandoned the effort. | The run is terminal and its evidence remains readable. |

props.title: Decision (2026-08-11) — runs survive sync via remote-application boundaries

text.insert: Sync does not close the interrupted run. Upstream changes enter session lineage through the remote-application boundary contract while the run identity and original baseline stay fixed.
Run continuity separates the fixed origin of the effort from the head it plans against.

Pause is drain-based. active → draining disables new admission and claims while existing work settles; draining → paused records the settled state and releases autonomous scheduling authority. A confirmed hard stop may cancel outstanding subjects, but it also returns the same run to paused instead of closing its identity.

props.title: Decision (2026-08-11) — failed runs resume in place

text.insert: Recovery never creates a successor run. Failed runs return to paused on the same run identity, and only completed and cancelled are terminal.
Recovery first reconciles unfinished epoch boundaries, then settles or cancels orphaned claims and operations. The

| Condition | Observed activity |
| --- | --- |
| idle | No scheduler operation is executing. |
| planning | Candidate evidence is becoming an admission decision. |
| dispatching | Admitted work is being assigned to capacity. |
| waiting | The active run is sleeping for a durable wake event. |
| boundary | Confirmation, integration, report refresh, or save-point work is executing. |
| blocked | Progress requires recovery or operator action. |
